info.title: CRM Price Book Items Crm Reads Api

get.description: Retrieve a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by specifying properties, associations, and whether to include archived records. This endpoint is useful for fetching a list of objects with specific attributes or associations.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of CRM object to retrieve, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to include only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of property names to include in the response. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of properties to return along with their history of previous values. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored. Using this parameter reduces the maximum number of objects that can be read in a single request.

post.summary: Retrieve a batch of price book items
post.description: Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for fetching multiple objects in a single request, allowing for efficient data retrieval. You can specify whether to include archived objects in the results.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of CRM object to read in batch, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

get.description: Read an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object to read.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to read.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

id.description: The unique identifier of the associated object, represented as a string.

type.description: The type of the associated object, represented as a string.

AssociatedId.description: Contains the id and type of an association

inputs.description: An array of SimplePublicObjectId objects, each containing an 'id' field that specifies the internal ID of an object to be read.

properties.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be returned for each object. If a specified property is not present on the requested object(s), it will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If a specified property is not present on the requested object(s), it will be ignored.
